info.title: AI Document Intelligence / RAG Microservice
info.description: FastAPI service for document processing, RAG-based retrieval, and AI-powered query answering.

get.description: Readiness check — returns 503 if the service is not ready.

post.summary: Register a new organization and owner account
post.description:
Creates a new Organization + owner User in one atomic operation.
Returns a JWT you can use immediately for subsequent requests.
Email + password login. Returns a signed JWT.

get.description: Returns the currently authenticated user's profile.

get.summary: List all workspaces in your organization
get.description: Returns all workspaces belonging to the caller's organization.

post.summary: Create a new workspace in your organization
post.description: Creates a workspace scoped to the caller's organization.

post.summary: Issue a new sk-engram-* API key
post.description:
Generates a new `sk-engram-*` API key scoped to the specified workspace.

⚠️ The full key is returned **only once** — store it securely.
Only the first 20 characters (prefix) are stored server-side for display.

get.description:
Lists all active API keys for your organization.
Optionally filter by workspace_id query param.
Full key values are never returned — only the prefix.

delete.description:
Permanently deactivates an API key. Any requests using this key will
immediately receive 401. This action cannot be undone.

post.description: Create a new collection for the authenticated organization and workspace.

get.description: List all collections for the authenticated organization and workspace.

schema.title: Response List Collections Api V1 Collections Get

get.description: Get details of a specific collection in caller's workspace.

put.description: Update a specific collection in caller's workspace.

delete.description: Delete a specific collection from caller's workspace.

post.description:
Unified ingestion endpoint accepting either a file upload or a URL.
Tenant context (org_id, workspace_id, user_id) is automatically resolved from the API key.

get.description:
List all documents in the caller's workspace with pagination and status.
Workspace scope is derived automatically from the API key.
Poll processing status for a document.
Retrieve all indexed chunks for a specific document with pagination.

post.description: AI-powered query with full RAG pipeline. Tenant scope is resolved from the API key.

Retrieval-only search — returns ranked chunks without LLM generation.
Tenant scope is resolved from the API key.
